resolution_events.work_required: Define proposed action, payment, entry, pre/post effects, listener snapshots, death checkpoints and resumable choices. Add a general summon event only after its phase contract is established.

enchantments.work_required: Enumerate attached versus derived state, timestamp/order rules, zone transfer, copying, Silence and control-change behavior in one model.

generation_choices.work_required: Specify complete per-effect pools with exclusions and recursion; distinguish target randomness, deck choices and creation from external pools.

deck_legality.work_required: Independently verify target-date rotation, releases/bans, rune/copy limits, sideboards and exceptional deck construction before claiming full Standard.

combat_damage.work_required: Verify target legality, attack redirection, damage prevention, Poisonous/Lifesteal, terminal checkpoints and simultaneous damage.

zones_history.work_required: Define physical card identity, history counters, burn/discard/shuffle distinctions, resurrection and terminal draw behavior.

resources_classes.work_required: Check resource payment/rejection, persistent class counters and Hero Power cost/reset/replacement behavior.

secrets_locations.work_required: Generalize secret/listener ordering and location activation/reopen/destruction; add independent location scenarios after reviewing exact affected IDs.

dormant.work_required: Specify Dormant targeting, board occupancy, awakening clock and awakening event boundary; representative CORE_BT_156.

quests.work_required: Map each quest progress/reward condition and observation rules; do not equate a progress counter with a complete quest implementation.

hero_replacement.work_required: Review HERO card play, armor/health/weapon and Hero Power replacement/reset; representative CORE_EX1_323.

rewind.work_required: Define the exact reversible state and RNG/hidden-information behavior per card; exception rollback is not Rewind.

modern_keywords.work_required: Split into per-mechanic specifications (including Imbue, Herald, Shatter, Prepare, Kindred, Fabled, Colossal) before estimating implementation; composite category is not one feature.

fallback_review.work_required: Read every unmatched card manually; no keyword match does not imply a vanilla or easy card.
